Name: FS - Hoods and Hoodies
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/A9lZgWT.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Hoods and Hoodies is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds multiple recolorable hoodie accessories via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool. Additionally, this pack comes with pullstrings (static and animated), sleeves and dynamic hoods which can change form depending on your location or the weather.
[/size]

[b][size=3]How do I wear one of the hoodies?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "accessories" button.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]How do I wear one of the hoods?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "hats" button.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]How do I get my hood to automatically equip when outside?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "hats" button and use the "Dynamic Hood (Outdoors)" hat.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]How do I get my hood to automatically equip when outside and raining / snowing?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "hats" button and use the "Dynamic Hood (Rain or Snow)" hat.[/size]
[/list]
